name: Enterprise Decision, Claim and Evidence
constraints: WM-KNW-010 authors decision content and WM-REC-010 fixes the authentic issued expression.
Record text duplicated from decision content is a pinned transcription, never an independent authoring field.
Decision evidence bindings resolve to WM-KNW-008 citation identities.
Argument premises and conclusions resolve to pinned WM-KNW-007 claims or explicit local restatements.
Source material, citation stance, claim assessment and decision-local appraisal remain distinct.
Alternatives, evaluation rounds, objections and dissent are append-only.
Revocation, reopening and counter-evidence preserve earlier rationale and fixed expressions.
